Etobicoke appraisal came in low? Now what?

1) Ask your lender how much it will lend based on the appraised value. 2) Check your agreement for a financing condition and when it ends. 3) Work out the gap: you may need more down payment to close it. 4) Ask your Realtor and lawyer about your options before you remove any condition.

Send this to someone waiting on their appraisal. General information only, not legal, tax or mortgage advice. Lender rules and agreements vary.

caption:
Buying new in Caledon? Up to $50,000 GST rebate.

1) What: a rebate of the GST, or the federal part of the HST, on a newly built home. 2) Who: eligible first-time buyers; for builder purchases, agreements signed on or after Mar 20, 2025. 3) How: ask your builder if they offer it, or apply to the CRA, usually within 2 years of taking ownership.

Source: Canada Revenue Agency, "First-time buyers can save more on new homes", Mar 17, 2026. Eligibility rules apply and other conditions may apply. General information only, not tax, mortgage or legal advice.

Moving to Georgetown? Nobody mentions #3.

1) Commute: test your real commute at rush hour. 2) Schools: ask the school board which school serves the address. 3) Property tax: ask for the latest tax bill; it varies by home.

General information only. Confirm details with the school board and the Town of Halton Hills.

Mississauga sellers: price high for negotiating room?

1) Start with what similar homes nearby actually sold for, not their asking prices. 2) Buyers compare homes online, so a price far from the market can turn them away. 3) Ask your Realtor for a market analysis of your street and home type. 4) You set the list price; your Realtor advises you with the sold data.
